title: The own checker's witness search bounded by work: lib/tests/integration.rs, alignment.rs and observations.rs
description: After the first violation, the own checker searches the remaining paths for a witness in an earlier stage (lib/src/bmc/mod.rs, check). That search used to stop at as long again as the first violation took, at least a second, so on a loaded or slower machine it could stop sooner and report another witness: the last clock dependency in the own checker after VF-010. It now stops at as much solver work again (conflicts, at least PROBE_CONFLICTS) and as many paths again (at least 64), the same on every machine; a solver with no conflict limit keeps the time rule. The library's unit tests (211, with the reproducer the_search_for_a_smaller_witness_does_not_depend_on_the_clock, which fails on the old code under a solver 300 ms slower per call), foundations, compare, effects, heap, summaries and conformance (non-ignored) passed inline. This job runs the suites that weren't run inline, which several of run JBMC, at the commit that makes the change. Expected: every non-ignored test passes.

resources.notes: as the cleanup merge's integration job (2m37s, peak 2.0 GiB), plus two smaller suites

steps.name: integration, alignment and observations tests
steps.run: cd lib && CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 cargo test --test integration --test alignment --test observations
